import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
g = im.mean(2)
# find card: bright pixels (>140) in central area
mask = g>135
ys,xs = np.where(mask)
# restrict to card zone x 80..180, y 50..135
m2 = mask.copy()
m2[:48,:]=False; m2[136:,:]=False; m2[:,:78]=False; m2[:,180:]=False
ys,xs=np.where(m2)
print(\"card bbox x\",xs.min(),xs.max(),\"y\",ys.min(),ys.max())
# per-row left/right edges
for y in range(52,134,6):
    row=np.where(m2[y])[0]
    if len(row): print(y,row.min(),row.max())
# platform dark region near bottom center
for y in range(124,144):
    row=np.where(g[y]<70)[0]
    row=row[(row>80)&(row<190)]
    if len(row): print(\"plat\",y,row.min(),row.max())
# rod: dark narrow around x ~119 above card
for y in range(0,52,4):
    row=np.where(g[y]<60)[0]
    row=row[(row>100)&(row<140)]
    if len(row): print(\"rod\",y,row.min(),row.max(),len(row))
# silver rod top
for y in [2,6,10,14,18]:
    print(\"silver\",y, [ (x,tuple(im[y,x])) for x in range(115,126) if g[y,x]>120][:6])
# wire on right
for y in range(126,144,2):
    row=np.where(g[y]<55)[0]
    row=row[(row>150)]
    if len(row): print(\"wire\",y,row.min(),row.max())
EOF"
